notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Minor bugfixes:

- NPCs no longer repeat the player's last answer at the end of a dialogue.
- The button tutorial at level 3's gate properly shows up.
- Minor texture fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Minor bug fixes:

• Fixed a metal gate in level 5 which occasionally failed to open,
• Fixed a light effect error in level 4,
• Fixed a bug in the level select panel which prevented level 1 from being selected,
• The cursor now becomes invisible while the mouse is idle for more than two seconds.
